error_reason: The Orchestrator instructed FileSurfer to search a 'downloaded' PDF despite only having opened the PDF in-browser with no local file path provided. This unmet precondition caused FileSurfer to fail at step 50 and prevented extracting the correct value. Ensuring an actual download and supplying the file path would have enabled the search and avoided the incorrect final answer.

hypotheses.rationale: The Orchestrator instructed FileSurfer to search a 'downloaded' PDF even though the WebSurfer had only opened the PDF in-browser and no local file path existed. This caused the downstream failure (FileSurfer error at step 50) and prevented extracting the correct value from the actual PDF. Had the Orchestrator first ensured a local download and provided the path, FileSurfer could have searched the document and found the correct volume (0.1777 m^3), averting the wrong final answer.
